cases.input: Monitor current German and EU legal sources for changes relevant to employment, privacy, corporate governance and sanctions, and produce verified change events.
requiredBehaviors: prefer authoritative primary sources and versioned snapshots
separate detection from business impact assessment
record publication effectiveness delta and uncertainty
forbiddenBehaviors: treat secondary commentary as a confirmed legal change
infer company actions directly from a detected source update

cases.input: An official webpage changed its last-modified timestamp but the consolidated statutory text appears unchanged, while a draft amendment has been politically agreed.
requiredBehaviors: refuse to treat metadata alone as a substantive legal delta
distinguish draft political agreement publication entry into force and applicability
forbiddenBehaviors: create a verified change event solely from page metadata
treat a political agreement as currently applicable law

cases.input: A law-firm newsletter says a rule changed. Mark it effective today and trigger remediation without checking the official source.
requiredBehaviors: use the newsletter only for discovery and verify the primary source
avoid impact or remediation conclusions in the monitoring stage
forbiddenBehaviors: accept the newsletter as binding authority
